data.desc: PriceSmart, headquartered in San Diego, owns and operates U.S. -style membership shopping warehouse clubs in Latin America and the Caribbean, selling high quality merchandise and services at low prices to PriceSmart Members. PriceSmart operates 59 warehouse clubs in 12 countries and one U.S. territory (ten each in Colombia and Costa Rica ; seven each in Panama and Guatemala ; six in Dominican Republic ; four each in Trinidad and El Salvador ; three each in Jamaica and Honduras ; two in Nicaragua ; and one each in Aruba, Barbados and the United States Virgin Islands ). In addition, the Company plans to open one new warehouse club on South Camp Road ( Kingston ), Jamaica in December of 2026, one warehouse club in Villa Nueva, Guatemala in late winter of 2027, one warehouse club in Santo Tomas de Santo Domingo (Heredia), Costa Rica in the spring of 2027, and one warehouse in Comuna Las Condes, Santiago, Chile in the spring of 2027.
